Hello,

Not what I was hoping for either but I'll wait for the nerdoctaxe. Is there
a way I can get notified when you are expecting stock?

Thank you
Handed to the team · No restock date exists for the NerdOctaxe; customer needs one and a stock notifi

Hi Patrick,

Thanks for coming back, and sorry again about the NerdOctaxe. Your order stays as it is then: the NerdOctaxe and the Power Kit stay on it and ship to you as soon as stock lands, at no extra cost.

On being notified, yes. You are on the list for this order, so the moment that stock is booked in you get an email from us with the date, and tracking when it goes out. You can also follow the inbound shipments yourself on our shipment status page, https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status, which shows each batch on its way to our warehouse and which orders it covers. Worth adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts so those updates do not land in junk. I have also asked a colleague to come back to you today with a real restock date rather than leaving you guessing.

On your other question, the Bitfortun BS-4 at 18 TH/s is the one swap I can do for you if you change your mind. It is $599.99 against the $359.99 on your Octaxe line, so $240.00 difference, invoiced to you, and it ships from the manufacturer by Oct 31, 2026. No rush, the offer stands, just say the word and I will run it.

Your $50 code HD-•••••• is still yours either way.

Thanks for your patience with this one, Patrick.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Good morning,

Any updates on this? With having to pay extra I'd like to get this ordered

Handed to the team · swap_done log

Good morning Patrick,

Done. Your order Shop···· now holds the Bitfortun BS-4 at 18 TH/s in place of the NerdOctaxe, same order number, and it ships from the manufacturer by Oct 31, 2026.

One correction I owe you on the money. The $240 I quoted was off the list price, and what you actually paid on the Octaxe line was $272.18 after the discount, so the real difference is $327.81. That invoice is on its way to you now, and the BS-4 ships once it is paid. Sorry for the mix-up in the figure, I would rather you heard the right number from me than find it on the invoice.

Your $50 code HD-•••••• is still yours and unused, so you can put it against a future order whenever you like.

The P. Kit line stays on the order and still ships to you separately at no extra cost once stock lands. You can follow the inbound shipments on our shipment status page, https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status, and tracking comes to this address when it goes out.

Thanks for sticking with us on this one, Patrick.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

I really appreciate it. It's been great working with you and will
